title: Terminator 3 - Rise of the Machines
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

rows: the T-850 fights through missions from the film

widgets.text: Health bar; weapons and ammo picked up from fallen enemies

Guns picked up during missions
Heavy weapons have limited ammo: keep a pistol-class weapon for weak enemies
Some missions put you in vehicles or protection roles (keep John Connor alive)

T-X encounters
The T-X is the recurring boss: hit her, then keep moving: she closes distance fast
Use cover; enemy robots fire in bursts

Missions following the film
Missions follow the film from the city streets to the final bunker

Ammo per weapon
Ammo per weapon; health packs in crates
Health packs and ammo crates are in side rooms

Hidden items
Hidden ammo caches in side rooms
Ammo caches are worth the detour on harder missions

Missions completed
Missions in order; the final mission is the bunker
